Evidence [3] from The Verge discusses Google's deals with Apple and others to be the default search engine. Evidence [7] from TechCrunch mentions Google's antitrust trial with Epic Games over Android app distribution and in-app payment issues. Evidence [8] from TechCrunch notes accusations of anticompetitive deals with Apple and others.
